mapper.select: SELECT ln.id, ln.link_id AS linkId, ln.node_id AS nodeId, ln.node_dict_id AS nodeDictId, ln.node_alias AS nodeAlias, ln.status, ln.edge_type AS edgeType, nd.node_code AS nodeCode, nd.api_code AS apiCode, nd.node_type AS nodeType, nd.node_name AS nodeName FROM biz_tracking_link_node ln INNER JOIN biz_tracking_node_dict nd ON ln.node_dict_id = nd.id AND ln.status = 1 WHERE ln.link_id = #{linkId}
